title: Backend command (iot/{site}/{sourceId}/{deviceId}/cmd)
description: Backend-issued downlink command. Published non-retained QoS1. SAFETY RULE: the device MUST drop any command whose expires_at has passed, and MUST never execute a command received before issuance — a command queued during an outage may only expire, never fire late.

command_id.description: Globally unique command identifier; echoed in the ack.

type.description: Command type from the backend whitelist (e.g. door_open, scene_start_class).

expires_at.description: Hard deadline, Unix milliseconds UTC. Default 30s, door-class commands should stay under 10s.
